relations_to.summary: Organization of Turkic States Secretary-General Kubanychbek Omuraliev paid his first visit to Mongolia in March 2025 at the invitation of Foreign Minister Battsetseg Batmunkh; he also met the secretary of the National Security Council. Mongolia is not an observer of the OTS, and no accession plan was found.
relations_to.note: The OTS observer list (Hungary, Turkmenistan, TRNC, ECO) does not include Mongolia.

sources.title: Secretary General of the OTS met with the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Mongolia

relations_to.summary: Erdogan attended the 12th summit of the Organization of Turkic States in Gabala on 7 Oct 2025 (Azerbaijan took the chair; the Gabala Declaration and an 'OTS+' format with third countries were adopted; Aliyev proposed joint exercises in 2026); the next regular summit is set for Türkiye in autumn 2026 and an informal one for Kazakhstan.

sources.title: 12th Summit of the Organization of Turkic States will be held in Gabala, Azerbaijan
12th Summit of the Council of Heads of State of the Organization of Turkic States commenced in Gabala
